result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.is_directed()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Check if the graph is directed. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L11164-L11216){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.is_directed() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Is directed](/assets/graphs/is-directed.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Left: a triangle whose edges carry arrowheads, a graph created as directed, so is_directed() returns True. Right: the same triangle drawn with plain lines, an undirected graph, so is_directed() returns False." width="100%"} Returns whether this graph treats edges as directed (with distinct source and target) or undirected (bidirectional connections). This property is set when the graph is created and cannot be changed afterward. In directed graphs: - edge `A->B` is different from `B->A` - each direction must be explicitly added - useful for modeling asymmetric relationships (follows, citations, etc.) In undirected graphs: - edge `A--B` is the same as `B--A` - adding `A--B` automatically adds `B--A` - useful for modeling symmetric relationships (friendship, proximity, etc.) ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `True` if the graph is directed, `False` if undirected. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#0719f34c .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec ec.Graph(directed=True).is_directed(), ec.Graph(directed=False).is_directed() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (True, False) ``` ::: ::: Branching on `is_directed()` lets the same code add the right number of edges for either kind of graph -- one call suffices for undirected, but both directions are needed for directed: ::: {#304006ab .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph(directed=True).add_node(label="A").add_node(label="B") if graph.is_directed(): graph.add_edge(source="A", target="B") graph.add_edge(source="B", target="A") else: graph.add_edge(source="A", target="B") graph.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
